name: AEVEX Corp.
description: AEVEX Corp is a defense technology company delivering next-generation navigation and autonomy, uncrewed systems, and adaptable mission solutions engineered to need, delivered at speed, and built for the modern battlespace. Its solutions are sold to agencies and organizations within the DoW, SOF, IC, and allied international partners. The group offers products and solutions such as CompassCore, CompassVision, CompassEngage, Precision Strike Systems, Unmanned Surface Vessels, Long Endurance Aircraft, Additive Manufacturing, Full Spectrum Airborne ISR, Aircraft Modification and Testing, and Others.
